svg.aria-label: C3 Ink and Fill character style sheet
svg.title: C3 Ink and Fill character style sheet
svg.text: C3 · Ink & Fill — character style sheet
Variable-width ink ribbons · flat fills · deliberate misregistration · warm paper. Spec document, not production art (labels use system fonts).
A · Line weights (units on a 256 canvas)
Silhouette 3.0–4.4 · hair, garment edge, crop ring
Ends taper to ≈45 %. Pressure is heavier on the shadow side (lower-right) and under the chin.
A stroke never has a uniform width. Wobble ≤ 0.35 units at 256, deterministic per feature,
so a face stays identical across expressions. Gaps allowed on interior lines, never on the silhouette.
B · Shading in three steps (light from upper-left)
No gradients, blur, soft shadows or second shadow tone. Highlights are paper showing through
(eye glint) or one lighter flat shape on hair. Environment pen: ink at 60 % width, 72 % opacity,
fills pushed toward paper tints, so the character always wins over the room.
One accent colour per character (band, earring, lapel); garments stay in the muted set. Skin tones are a four-step family that extends per course;
shadow tones are derived (−20 % lightness, +12 % saturation, hue nudged warm), never hand-picked.
✓ tapered ribbon strokes, heavier on the shadow side
✓ flat fills offset from the ink (two-pass print feel)
✓ warm paper backgrounds, ink is warm near-black, never #000
✓ contemporary clothing you would see in that city today
✓ one accessory that carries the silhouette (band, glasses, lapel)
✓ expressions through brows + mouth + head tilt + one hand
✕ gradients, blur, soft drop shadows, glossy highlights
✕ cross-hatching everywhere — three lines maximum per area
✕ baked-in text, logos, flags, national or religious costume
✕ real-person likeness or recognisable brand characters
✕ pure black ink, saturated neon fills, pastel vignettes
F · Scale and grayscale check (neutral portraits at 96, 48 and 24 px; right column desaturated)
At 24 px the ink collapses to a halo and the fills carry recognition: hair mass + skin + one accent colour + the garment tone must stay four distinct grayscale values.
For icon exports (< 48 px) regenerate with ink × 1.6 and drop hatching, lid creases and age marks (figure(ink=1.6) in the generator).
